study.question: Does an ad-conditioned direction derived from attended within-history dispersion add useful information beyond the aligned product-of-means incumbent and a capacity-matched nonlinear transformation of its first moments?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: source inspection shows that the incumbent keeps only the category and brand attention-weighted means hc/hb before explicit value products. Thus, conditional on the same means, common read and attention weights, different event dispersion cannot affect its readout. This is an architectural information loss, not an observed causal explanation for residual prediction error. The latest aligned_target replay has AUC 0.6162637997271082 and Logloss 0.19651406011090977; crossed_target has AUC 0.6151190736939028. The alignment advantage is 0.0011447260 with target operands versus 0.0002682393 with context operands, factorial difference 0.0008764867, all one seed. Round-7 product versus additive gave +0.0010960723 for target and +0.0002253351 for context. These motivate preserving aligned field semantics while examining a different statistic. Weighted diagonal variance may retain target-relevant diversity/cancellation hidden by the mean. With q fixed per impression, Var(q*x)=q^2*Var(x). Its normalized coordinate direction may improve ranking beyond the equally sized squared-mean branch. The evidence does not yet show this missing statistic is predictive.

nearest_work.difference: Primary source motivates explicit candidate/history interactions, per-layer dot/Gram highways, dual buses and conditional sequence gating. The inherited local adaptation uses a single coordinatewise post-retrieval product map. This study adds a centered event-dispersion statistic and compares it to a first-moment nonlinear branch; it implements no highway, repeated buses, auxiliary delay labels or mutual learning. Statistical pooling has broad prior art; novelty remains unverified.

Retain the incumbent field-aligned target retrieval, aligned product values, shared 16x16 value map and norm matching. Add a distinct zero-start 16x16 moment map and either weighted centered variance or squared attended means. Initial predictions equal the incumbent initial function, but training remains from scratch and weights are never loaded from the ancestor.

inherited_components: Field embeddings shared between static ad and history field IDs; action and log-age embeddings; field-specific target queries and shared local attention MLP
Separate category/brand normalized reads and averaged common-feature weights; incumbent aligned target-product residual; unchanged classifier and norm matching

Host-owned raw tables, causal split/feature construction, masking, history truncation, label visibility, recipe and validation scoring; raw physical files are intentionally inaccessible in this coding phase

Trajectory review: pooled 0.610226 < adapted DIN 0.613362 < separate aligned target reads 0.615335. Union reads (g2-r0002-union_target 0.614920), action-normalized reads (g2-r0003-action_target 0.614401), semantic-only keys (g2-r0005-semantic_target 0.614065) and cross-query projection (g2-r0006-cross_target 0.615017 versus self_target 0.615122) did not improve their incumbent; these branches are retained as null/negative evidence, not discarded or generalized to refutations of their source methods

No failures are present in the supplied trajectory index and previous_runtime_error is null; no inaccessible outcomes are inferred
study.proposed_difference: Four-cell prospective replacement factorial. All cells keep the incumbent target-product branch. Compute vc=sum_j wc_j*(category_j-hc)^2 and vb analogously, with padded positions weighted zero. The new raw driver is qc^2*vc+qb^2*vb (variance) or qc^2*hc^2+qb^2*hb^2 (mean_square), where q is either current-ad category/brand or masked history field means only for the new branch. Normalize each nonzero raw driver to ||concat(hc,hb)||, map through a new shared D x D zero-start projection, and add before the inherited final summary norm matching. Thus the comparison concerns target-gated coordinate dispersion direction, not unconstrained variance magnitude. All variants calculate both variance tensors in the forward path, but backward work can differ. Each module is standalone and differs only in its two literal config switches. No training, installations or extra agents are launched here.
predictions: Primary Delta_T=AUC(variance_target)-AUC(mean_square_target)>0, with variance_target also exceeding historical incumbent g2-r0007-product_target/g2-r0008-aligned_target (0.6162637997271082); report both comparisons and unweighted Logloss, including disagreements

For specifically ad-conditioned dispersion, factorial I=Delta_T-[AUC(variance_context)-AUC(mean_square_context)]>0. Context here changes only the added moment operand: retrieval and the inherited product branch remain target-conditioned in every cell

A useful new branch should learn a nonzero moment projection and change logits when disabled. Variance zeroing at frozen reads should change variance-cell logits, while the mean_square control should be exactly invariant; these measure implementation use, not accuracy or causal benefit

Centered variance should be nonnegative and zero for empty or singleton histories (within numerical tolerance); padded attention mass and empty summaries should be zero, attention sums near one for active histories, and summary norm errors near roundoff

Exploratory effect may be larger with longer supplied histories, but sample composition and counts matter. Use existing fixed host history bins, action presence, frequency and time slices with their positive/negative counts; do not use first-512 diagnostic groups as population performance evidence
falsifiers: Delta_T<=0 weakens this implementation of added dispersion; beating the incumbent alone while failing to beat mean_square_target supports extra nonlinear capacity rather than dispersion specificity
I<=0 fails the claim that the dispersion advantage specifically needs the current ad as the added operand; positive context effects can still support a more general dispersion mechanism

Failure to beat the incumbent, persistent Logloss degradation, excessive time/memory cost, or unstable repeats prevents selection as a better supported model even if some diagnostic intervention changes logits

Nonfinite execution, leakage, large norm/padding/empty-history errors, or mean_square logits changing under frozen-read variance zeroing invalidate mechanism interpretation and require repair before scientific comparison

A failed or null variance implementation is not a refutation of all distributional pooling: the norm constraint, coordinate squaring, training dynamics and coarse supplied fields remain alternatives; retain its receipt and inspect diagnostics before deciding on one discriminating follow-up
alternative_explanations: Training is end-to-end: attention, embeddings and both residual maps can co-adapt, so this compares implementations rather than identifying a frozen-representation causal effect
Equal parameters and data passes do not imply equal effective function class, gradient conditioning, GPU time or memory; variance requires event-level backward computation
Diagonal dispersion depends on the learned embedding coordinate basis; squaring removes operand signs and driver normalization removes total dispersion magnitude
A zero/degenerate driver stays zero rather than receiving the reference direction; report incidence, since singleton/repeated-field or missing-field histories can differ between statistic cells

One paired seed and repeatedly reused validation are exploratory; differences cannot establish significance or generalization; first-512 diagnostics are unrepresentative candidate-supplied measurements
Model may exploit embedding anisotropy or history composition as nuisance proxies rather than meaningful diversity; observed event count alone does not establish multi-interest structure

Earlier gains or failures can reflect fixed-seed optimization and validation search. Small history bins and missing-field groups may be insufficient; source pCVR/multi-domain results do not automatically transfer to this CTR setting
Publisher static snapshots have undocumented as-of dates and remain a benchmark assumption; this study does not repair or validate production point-in-time availability

This proposal preserves that compact inherited adaptation and examines information discarded by first-moment pooling; it does not reproduce source leaderboard performance.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: Retain explicit aligned target/history product residual; add q-squared weighted event dispersion and test against q-squared first-moment replacement at matched parameter count, with target/context operand controls.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: Centered diagonal variance under existing field-specific attention and a single normalized D x D value map; no per-layer dot highway, dual buses, large token backbone or mutual-learning loss. Priority and novelty are unverified.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: Nonpositive Delta_T fails dispersion specificity; nonpositive factorial I fails added-target specificity. Neither outcome assesses full UniDot.
